summary: Husted voted against discharging S.J. Res. 32 and S.J. Res. 138, blocking congressional disapproval of military sales to Israel including D9 bulldozers and 1,000-lb bomb bodies.
quote: On April 15, 2026, Husted voted against motions to discharge S.J. Res. 32 and S.J. Res. 138 from the Senate Foreign Relations Committee. The resolutions would have advanced congressional disapproval of proposed military sales to Israel, including Caterpillar D9 bulldozers and 1,000-pound bomb bodies
